corrections.why: The NHLR Built field reads 1930's and its description says apparently built in the 1930's per Thornton's 1986 survey. The record's single year 1930 is more precise than the source supports

notes_for_editor: Very thin record. The NHLR detail page is the only substantive source and says very little is known. Build date: the record's 1930 is more precise than the Register's 1930's, so a correction is proposed rather than applied. The brief's kind 'two_story' is not supported by any source read; the Register gives no storey count, only the design resemblance to Green Mountain Lookout. Please check it. Brief's 'standing' is not stated by any source read; no current condition is recorded. Access 'restricted' is an inference from tribal land and Bureau of Indian Affairs administration; no source states visitor rules, so the story now says not to assume public access and to ask the tribe or BIA first. The Forest Lookouts page has no body text beyond its heading and one line. Not read: Thornton's 1986 survey. No photos added; the Register shows a Fred Johnson photo but I did not read its file. Page reads: 4 total (NHLR, Forest Lookouts twice, Hupa Wikipedia). WebSearch: 1.
